slots.rationale: R30, R46, R38: a perpetual-adoration chapel open around the clock only to scheduled adorers; the public may come 6 AM-9 PM. Leaning to the hours the public can come, daily 6 AM-9 PM, as bread-of-life-catholic-community recorded a chapel whose '24 hours' were for scheduled adorers. Answer together with the separate 24-hour question (lean: leave that out); choose one of the two, not both. Location: the parish has one church; p4 lists Church and Chapel memorials (sanctuary lamp, vigil light) side by side and the website calls it 'our chapel ... here at St. Mary', so it is on the campus (as ss-philip-and-james-exton s15, sacred-heart-havertown s13). No exposition claimed in the note (R38).

src.said: Our Divine Mercy Adoration Chapel is open to the general public from 6am to 9pm. Scheduled adorers only from 9pm to 6am.

resolution.why: R46, R30: the same chapel is already asked about. s24 offers 'One 24-hour chapel, by arrangement' (adoration 24h, the R46 form of luna's 00:00-23:59 entry, which has no day), and group 'chapel' (s17-s23) offers its public hours, daily 6 AM-9 PM. The bulletin limits the overnight hours to scheduled adorers, so how to record it is the reviewer's call. Luna's note also folds in the Thursday-before-first-Friday Holy Hour, which s15 leaves out under R33.
